The '''''Far Ranger''''' was a heavily modified [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI bulk transport]] originally owned by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Drach Coven]]. It was later handed over to former-[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nick Rostu]]. Rostu had found an enigmatic power hilt in one of the weapons cache aboard the Ranger. Rostu, despite his curiosity, didn't activate it with suspicions of it being a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. During the fight in Yaam sector with [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], the hilt was given to [[Jax Pavan]]. The hilt was then discovered to be a [[Lightwhip/Legends|light whip]].
